title: Leaving in 1931 and when Buddy Petit died
summary: Humphrey left March 31, 1931, Petit was still alive then, and he only heard of the death after returning in 1941.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
